name: Sonne Steel
old_description: DESIGN, ENGINEERING, FABRICATION, AND FULL ERECTION SINCE 2005
about:
Sonne Steel was founded in 2005 in Smithfield, Kentucky, by Eric Sonne and Ben Tribble. Both graduates of the Speed Scientific School of Engineering at the University of Louisville — Sonne holds a master’s in mechanical engineering, Tribble a bachelor’s — they launched the company to serve the residential housing market with steel fabrication and installation.

Today the firm operates a 36,000-square-foot manufacturing facility and delivers design, engineering, fabrication, and full erection for residential and commercial projects. Using Tekla 3D modeling software linked to automated shop equipment, the team handles beam design, load calculations, complete layout, and detailing, then fabricates structural members, stair towers, and railings. Products ship anywhere in the United States; erection crews work within a 200-mile radius of Louisville.

The customer base spans residential builders, commercial contractors, and manufacturing plants that need structural and miscellaneous steel. Past projects include residential steel packages, commercial stair towers and railings, and industrial facility steelwork.

Sonne Steel emphasizes on-time delivery driven by Tekla production software that tracks materials, production, and deliveries from model to shop floor. The founders say the automated workflow eliminates manual errors and reduces project cost and schedule risk.
